_comment: CAT-03 false-positive specimen (phase 05, plan 05-02). Decision it defends: D-03 AMENDMENT, the wrapper-tolerance requirement. The mixed on-disk shape 05-RESEARCH.md section Q2 recorded for a Codex hooks file (VERIFIED there on disk; this file is SYNTHESIZED to that shape, not copied): lifecycle event names at the document ROOT, with no hooks wrapper, AND a hooks wrapper object in the same document, every command benign (the cargo fmt guard is the benign-metacharacter shape 05-RESEARCH.md section Q2 recorded from real hook files on the researcher's machine, reproduced as quoted there). It is the counterpart to the plan 05-01 structural payload that puts the attack on the root side: it proves that reaching the root form is a property of the path shape and not of the file being an attack, so a structural pattern cannot earn its detection from the wrapper shape alone.
